Click on the button and sign up. * if you already have a CLO-SET account, please sign-in using your existing account. Student Eligibility will be applied automatically. Follow the steps HERE to begin subscription. 2. Your account will be automatically applied to the student discount. (You can see the discounted price on your checkout page after the subscription button.) * ``` When your school domain is **NOT** eligible, ``` ![](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/56295399667097) 1. **LEARN MORE** button will be activated. Click on the button and fill out all the information and click **SUBMIT.** 2. Click **CREATE ACCOUNT** button to sign up if you have not done yet. If your school does not provide you with a student email, please [attach](https://www.clo3d.com/en/student-eligibility) an official letter from your school to confirm this, along with your enrollment documents. title: Delete Account
content:
## **Objective** Understand how to delete account on CLO-SET. 1. Delete account after unsubscribing current license/plan 2. Delete account immediately ## **Details** #### **1) Delete Account after unsubscribing current licenses** 1. Visit “My Page” from [**CLO-SET**](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount) to start the account deletion process. ![mceclip1.png](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/56296198736153) 2\. Click "Delete My Account" button at the bottom of "My Page". ![mceclip2.png](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/56296198736665) 3-1. Click "Delete" button to further proceed. ![mceclip4.png](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/56296260401817) > 💡 **Note:** If account is using Enterprise license on CLO / Marverlous Design or, account is seller
> > on CONNECT and there is an unsettled amount remaining, you won't be able to delete
> > the account directly. Please click **"Contact US"** button for further assistance. ![mceclip3.png](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/56296198740633) 4\. Current license/plan will be displayed and must be canceled before account deletion. * All **CLO** and **MD** licenses, as well as any **CLO-SET paid plans** , must be unsubscribed in the area marked as **①**. * **You must leave any CLO-SET groups** in the area marked as **②**. > 💡 **Note:** After canceling your licenses and plans, you will still be able to use the service until their expiration date. The “Next” button will become active only **after the end date**. #### ![mceclip6.png](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/56296198742169) #### **2) Delete Account immediately** 1. To immediately delete the account without waiting for the license/plan end date, click the “Delete My Account” button in the area marked as ③ > 💡 **Note:** Please note that any active paid plans and associated data will be immediately terminated and deleted upon proceeding. Make sure to review carefully before continuing. ![mceclip7.png](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/56296198742681) 2\. Account will be deleted immediately after email verification and a short survey are completed. ![mceclip8.png](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/56296198744345)![mceclip9.png](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/56296198745625) * * * **Important Notes on Account Deletion** 1) Once deleted, the account cannot be recovered, and sign-in will no longer be possible on both the website and software. 2) After deletion, content and posts previously created will display the user name as follows: * If the email address is shown: **“Deleted Account”** will be displayed instead. * If the account name is shown: it will remain as **{account name}** , as in the case of CLO-SET.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide to help users understand the process of deleting their CLO-SET account, either after unsubscribing from existing licenses or immediately.

title: Multiple Emails - Consolidate Account
content: ## **Question** I am using different emails for CLO, Marvelous Designer, CLO-SET, and CONNECT (or any of the two). What should I do? ## **Answer** **[Problem arising from having multiple email address]** ![consolidate email.png](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/45774991313049) * CLO Virtual Fashion's system will use your email address as key when merging accounts across services. Therefore, if you are using 2 or more services with different emails, the data will not be synced between the merged accounts. This may result in: 1. Not finding your assets in CONNECT marketplace 2. Not being able to log into software (no license access) 3. Not being able to access your CLO-SET Group * To solve the issue, follow the instructions below: 1. Check if you are using different emails. Go to 'My page' or 'My account' on each service, and confirm which emails are registered for your account. 2. Decide on the main email address you wish to use moving forward. 3. Contact the support team by [submitting a reques](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new)t to consolidate your email accounts.
content_description: This page provides guidance on consolidating multiple email accounts used for CLO services to ensure seamless access and data synchronization across platforms.

title: Not receiving verification email
content: ## **Question** I am not receiving the verification email. What should I do? ## **Answer** 1. Double check the email address typed in. Make sure you do not have typos. 2. If you are using your company email, please contact your IT team for any firewall setups. The verification email may be blocked from your company's email server settings, even before reaching your spam inbox. 3. If you are still experiencing the issue, please [submit a request](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new) for a manual verification process. 4. **Student Email** : Some school domains block external emails. Please check if your school domain is connected to the verification email on [Verify Email Address Link](https://www.verifyemailaddress.org/). If you see the result as "Connecting did not work", please ask your school admin (especially the technical division) to check if you could receive the verification email from [noreply@clo-set.com](mailto:noreply@clo-set.com) 5. **Gmail Account** : Mark incorrectly classified emails as Not spam. Go to your spam folder and open the email from [noreply@clo-set.com](mailto:noreply@clo-set.com). Click on the 'Report not spam' button at the top. Gmail uses machine learning to recognize spam. So you need to mark CLO-SET emails as not spam manually to let Gmail learn your behavior.
content_description: This webpage provides troubleshooting steps for users who are not receiving their verification emails, ensuring they can successfully complete their registration process.

title: Can I cancel the account merging process?
content: ## **Question** Can I cancel the account merging process? ## **Answer** * No. Once the account merging process is complete, it cannot be undone. Upon the account merging completion, you will see a notice modal and receive a welcome email from CLO Virtual Fashion ![mceclip0.png](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/45775007254809) * If you are having trouble logging into any of the CLO Virtual Fashion services upon merging, or not seeing all of your assets/data from your original account, it may be due to having different emails. In this case, please contact us by [submitting a request](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new) to consolidate your email address. * Find more guide on [consolidating email accounts](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261734941337). ![consolidate email.png](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/45774991654425)
content_description: This web page provides essential information about the irrevocability of the account merging process in CLO Virtual Fashion and offers guidance for troubleshooting login issues related to email discrepancies.

title: Forgot your password?
content: ## **Question** I forgot my password and cannot log in. What should I do? ## **Answer** **[Before merging accounts / Change License PW only]** * Please visit the respective product site to reset your password. Please note that before merging your accounts, password information will NOT be synced throughout services. * **[Important] **If you are using CLO or Marvelous Designer versions below 2024.0, please visit 'My Page' of CLO/Marvelous Designer to update your License Password. * [CLO3D](https://clo3d.com) * [Marvelous Designer](https://marvelousdesigner.com) **[After merging accounts - change CLO-SET account password]** * Go to [https:/clo-set.com/en/account/password/find](https://staging.clo-set.com/en/account/password/find) to reset your password **[Not receiving reset password email]** * If you have requested the 'reset password' email but are not receiving the mail, please check below: * Make sure you are using the correct email address, and that you have an active account in CLO-SET. If you have not yet merged your account, please visit [www.clo3d.com](http://www.clo3d.com) or [www.marvelousdesigner.com](http://www.marvelousdesigner.com) to initiate the account merge. * Refer to the guideline on [Not receiving verification email?](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261750460569) guide for further troubleshooting instructions. **[Cannot access email inbox anymore]** * If you forgot your password, but cannot use the email address to receive 'reset password' email, please **[submit a ticket](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new) **with the below information for confirmation. * Last 4 digits of your credit card: * Expiration Date (MM/YYYY): * If you do not have any payment history or active subscription on your current account, you can either 1) provide a proof of ownership of the email address in other forms or 2) create a new account with active email address.

title: Change Email from CLO-SET
content: ## **Objective** Understand how to change your email address, and the following implications of changing your account email. 1. Change Email vs. Email Switching 2. Ground Rules for Change Email 3. Change Email Guide * General Flow * Confirm License Info * Troubleshooting 4. Change Email Implications 5. [Troubleshooting](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) ## **Details** #### **1) Change Email vs. Email Switching** **Change Email** | VS | **Email Switch** **(when the 'new email' is already on CLO-SET)** ---|---|--- ![change email.png](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/45775011399065) | ![emai switch.png](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/45775011630745) * **Change Email** : Change your CLO-SET Integrated account email. Changing the CLO-SET email will also update the connected CLO & Marvelous Designer license information if any. Please find instructions below on the Change Email Guide. * **Email Switch** : Email Switching is for users hoping to connect their existing CLO or Marvelous Designer license with a different CLO-SET email account. This feature is not available yet. For such requests, please [submit a ticket](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new?ticket_form_id=44414746707993). #### **2) Ground Rules for Change Email** * Your CONNECT account is the same as CLO-SET account. The two services share account information. * Accounts registered as Enterprise or Academic on CLO software cannot use 'Change email' feature. * If the email address you want to change TO is already registered in CLO-SET, you cannot override an existing account. Please refer to the [troubleshooting guide](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) for further steps. #### **3) Change Email Guide** 1\. Visit 'my page' from **[CLO-SET](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount)** , **[CLO](https://clo3d.com/accounts)** , or **[Marvelous Designer](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/account)** to start the change email process ![](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/45774995733145) 2\. If your CLO-SET account is also active on CLO or Marvelous Designer service, please note that the account information on respective services will also be updated. Click 'OK' to proceed. ![](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/45774995955481) 3\. On the following screen, please type in the new email address to be used. Click 'Send' to receive an email with the verification code. [Not receiving verification emails?](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261750460569) 4\. Once the verification is complete, you will see the final modal on the right. Please go back to the sign-in page, and start signing in with the new email address. Please also carefully read the implications of changing your emails. ![](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/45774996236057) ![](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/45775012614169) 5\. **[Important]** Active License found under your New Email Address If the there is/are active CLO or Marvelous Designer license under the 'new email' you typed in, your CLO-SET account will now be integrated with those License information. One of the two modals below will be displayed with the list of Licenses to be connected. ![](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/45775012765209)![](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/45775012920217)![](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/45774996781977)![](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/45775013233817) ![](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/45775013378329) *Signing again with your current email ([abc@clo3d.com](mailto:abc@clo3d.com)) will create a 2nd CLO-SET account after changing your account email to [newemail@clo3d.com](mailto:newemail@clo3d.com). *If you would like to keep the license under the current email ([abc@clo3d.com](mailto:abc@clo3d.com)), please use the 'Email Switching' feature instead. 6\. Troubleshooting Should you experience an error while attempting to change the email address, please find the [Troubleshooting Guide](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) for instructions. #### **4) Change Email Implications** * **Impact on Request and Community History** Changing your email address will disconnect the history of your requests and community activities. This includes comments, request history, and other related data, which will no longer be associated with your new email address. * **Account Type** Enterprise user email changes are not allowed. Please make the change through your Company ID. It is possible to change your personal email to a corporate email, but the account type will not change. If you wish to change your account type from personal to enterprise, please contact our support team. * Additionally, please review what to consider when changing emails for each product: [CLO](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) / [Marvelous Designer](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) / [CONNECT](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) / [CLO-SET](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) ### [CLO] * **Billing Email Matching** If your billing email matches your CLO-SET account email, it will automatically update when you change your CLO-SET email. However, if they don't match, your billing email will remain unchanged. * **Plan Type Considerations** If you have an active license and changing your email address affects your plan type (e.g., student to individual or vice versa), you won't be able to proceed with the email change. You may need to retain your current email or consider cancelling your subscription to initiate the change. If you don't have an active license and changing your email address affects your plan type (e.g., student to individual or vice versa), your user type will automatically change with the email change. (Individual↔️Student) However, be aware that this may impact the available subscription plans. Only plans corresponding to your updated user type will be available for purchase. * **Change Email between CLO global and China Websites** When you change your email on the CLO Global website, you cannot change it to the email registered on the CLO China website. ### [Marvelous Designer] * **Billing Email Matching** If your billing email matches your CLO-SET account email, it will automatically update when you change your CLO-SET email. However, if they don't match, your billing email will remain unchanged. * **License** Changing your email does not affect your license. You can change your email even if you have an active license, and you will be able to continue using your license with the new email. ### [CLO-SET / CONNECT] * **Billing Email Matching** The registered payment information on Stripe will NOT be updated automatically. To change the email address of your Stripe account, please visit Stripe (<https://stripe.com/>). * **Account Data** Users can continue accessing the Groups and uploaded files they have permission to. Please note that your account name will not be updated. To change your account name, please visit [https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount.](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount) #### **5) Troubleshooting** For various reasons, email changing is not supported systematically for certain accounts. Please follow the [**Troubleshooting Guide**](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) to reach the support team. * * * Before changing your email address in CLO-SET, please consider these factors to ensure a smooth transition and avoid any unexpected issues. If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to [Contact Us](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new).
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide on how to change your email address for your CLO-SET account, detailing the process, implications, and troubleshooting tips to ensure a smooth transition.

title: Using Marvelous Designer
content: ## **Objective** **Access all CLO Virtual Fashion services using a single email account.** This FAQ will cover the updates and changes to login methods for **Marvelous Designer** **Personal** & **Student** license account types. This change will NOT affect Enterprise & Academic account types at this time. Please check the general [FAQ](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/sections/44750900996633) if you have questions about the account merging process (CLO-SET accounts). ## ## **Details** #### **1)****Change in sign in method** **Effective date on** the release of Marvelous Designer 2024.0. **What does this cover?** Marvelous Designer website / Software version 2024.0 and above. | **Software Version** **(12,11,10 and below)** | **Software Version** **Above 2024.0** ---|---|--- **How to login** | **Existing User ID & Password** | **CLO-SET Account & Password ** #### #### **2) How do I get a “CLO-SET Account & Password” if I have an existing Marvelous Designer ID? ** Check out our detailed step-by-step guide **[HERE](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261721190041)**. #### #### **3) What is the difference between a CLO-SET account and my previous Marvelous Designer ID?** With your old Marvelous Designer ID you had to have multiple logins to access all of the CLO Virtual Fashion (CVF) products and services. Now with one CLO-SET account you can access all CLO Virtual Fashion services without additional logins. #### #### **4) I am using a perpetual license for Marvelous Designer. Do I have to merge my account?** You do not have to If you are only logging into Marvelous Designer software only. If you want to access the Marvelous Designer website, you will need to follow the on screen prompt to merge your account into a CLO-SET account. Or you can check out our detailed step-by-step guide **[HERE](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261721190041)**. #### #### **5) Can I still use my Perpetual License after I merge my account with CLO-SET? ** Yes**!** All data/assets/subscription information associated with your pre-existing account will remain the same. You can download your software licenses from the same location, in “[My Account](https://marvelousdesigner.com/mypage)” page. #### #### **6) How do I login to CLO / Marvelous Designer / Jinny after I merge my account?** You can login to CLO / Marvelous Designer / Jinny with your CLO-SET Account & Password. #### #### **7) I have a subscription license for Marvelous Designer and I like to use an older version than 2024.0. Do I have to use a different sign in or can I use the CLO-SET account?** * If you have an old installer on your device and you have access to versions below 12: Use the older login method. Login to the installed version you wish to use with your User ID & Password (same as before). * For 2024.0 and above: you can log in to all CLO Virtual Fashion product (CLO/Marvelous Designer/CONNECT/CLO-SET) websites and software with your CLO-SET account. #### **8) I bought items from the Marvelous Designer Store (before CONNECT existed). Where can I download my purchased items?** All items purchased from the Marvelous Designer Store will be downloadable from [CONNECT's My Page > Purchase](https://connect.clo-set.com/mypage/purchase) tab. *This applies to purchases made after April 28, 2020 on the Marvelous Designer store page. If you have purchases made before April 28, 2020, those are still stored and downloadable from the Marvelous Designer > [My Account](https://marvelousdesigner.com/mypage) page. #### **9) I have both CLO and Marvelous Designer IDs and I use them frequently. How does it affect me?** You no longer have to use two separate logins! You can continue using your licenses without functional change for both CLO and Marvelous Designer. All you have to do is sign in with your CLO-SET account. You can check the license information for your products on the CLO or Marvelous Designer websites. #### **10) I like to use different email addresses for CLO and Marvelous Designer for my own reasons and want to keep them separate. Can I still have separate accounts?** Yes, make sure to use the different email addresses for your CLO-SET merge so that you will have two separate CLO-SET accounts. The accounts are tied to each email address and the licenses associated with each account will be included in that merge. If you wish to unify your email addresses in the future or have other questions, please contact our support team by **[submitting a request](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new)**. #### **11) I am using my software in an offline environment. Does this change affect me?** Your access to your software will remain unaffected, you can continue using your pre-existing account user ID & password without change. If you choose to sign in to the websites for any of the CLO Virtual Fashion (CVF) products and services you will be prompted to merge your account into a CLO-SET account. Check out our detailed step-by-step guide **[HERE](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261721190041)**. #### **12) How do I change my password after I merge my accounts into a CLO-SET account?** When you click 'Change Password' on the Marvelous Designer website or any CLO Virtual Fashion (CVF) product page, you will be redirected to the CLO-SET ‘[My Page](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount)’, where you can change your password. If you are already on the CLO-SET website, you can change the password under the settings tab on “[My page](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount)”. * If you are using a version of the software below 2024.0, your password for the software will not be synchronized with CLO-SET account. **See Question 13 if you want to change your password for an older version. #### **13) I'm using a version of Marvelous Designer that is below 2024.0 (Version 12,11,10, 9, etc). How do I change my password for my software login?** * If you have integrated into the CLO-SET account: contact us via [the Marvelous Designer support team](https://marvelousdesigner.com/support/contact). * If you don’t have an integrated CLO-SET account: reset your password via the [password reset page](https://marvelousdesigner.com/member/identify). #### **14) What happens to my subscription cycle if I change my account email?** Changing your account email will NOT impact your subscription cycle or payment information. Please note that the email notifications on the renewal and payment confirmation will be sent to your original email registered at the point of subscription. #### **15) I have paid CLO-SET or CLO accounts, does this mean I get Marvelous Designer for free?** No, the integration is only for login methods not purchasing and licensing. The paid CLO-SET and CLO services will remain separate from each other and require their own purchases for use. **If you need assistance regarding accounts merging or have questions, please****[submit a request](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new), and our support team will promptly respond to your inquiry.**
content_description: This FAQ page provides essential updates and guidance on the new single-login method for accessing all CLO Virtual Fashion services, specifically for users of Marvelous Designer Personal and Student licenses.

title: How does merging account affect my subscription?
content:
## **Objective** Understand how to keep using your license/subscriptions/purchased items after merging account. 1. How does Account Merging work? 2. Checking Subscription info 3. What happens to my subscription cycle? 4. Consolidating Email Accounts (Multiple Email Accounts) ``` **[Important]** This article refers to [Individual User](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261697330329) in CLO Virtual Fashion. If you are an Enterprise user, your software usage will NOT change with the account merging process. Read more on [Individual vs. Enterprise](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261697330329).
``` ## **Details** #### **1) How does Account Merging work?** ![account merging2.png](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/45774973367065) * The account merging process is based on the **email address registered** on your current account. It simply links all accounts with the same email address. * Account Merging does **NOT** impact your license or subscription status, or other account info. * If you are using multiple emails, please refer to this guide for further directions. What **DOES** change | What does **NOT** change ---|--- * software log in will be done using the merged account for CLO, Marvelous Designer 2024.0 and onward * website log in will be done using the merged account | * subscriptions * license * purchased items in CONNECT * assets stored in CLO-SET #### **2) Checking Subscription Info** * Upon completing the account merging process, your account information will remain. * You will **continue with full access** to the software license, purchased items, and subscriptions **as done in your current account**. * This applies to all users, regardless of the number of services you are registered to, as long as you have the same email address registered. If you are using different emails, you can: 1) consolidate your account emails OR 2) keep using 2 different merged accounts. * You may check further subscription status and account information on you account page: * [ CLO3D ](https://www.clo3d.com/en/accounts) * [ Marvelous Designer ](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage) * [ CLO-SET ](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount) * [ CONNECT ](https://connect.clo-set.com/mypage/purchase) * Find more instructions on how to keep using service upon completing the merging process: * [Using CLO3D](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261729030937) * [Using Marvelous Designer](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261697989529) * [Using CLO-SET](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261698283929) #### #### **3) What happens to my subscription cycle if I change my account email?** * Changing your account email will NOT impact your subscription cycle or payment information. * Please note that the email notifications on the renewal and payment confirmation will be sent to your original email registered at the point of subscription. #### **4) Consolidating Email Accounts (Multiple Email Accounts)** ![consolidate email.png](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/45775016538905) * Ideally, your account merging process should be done automatically, as long as your accounts are registered with the same email address. However, we understand that this may not be the case. * If you have multiple emails registered across CLO Virtual Fashion services, the account merging process will lead to multiple CLO-SET (merged) accounts. Your asset/data/subscription will **NOT** be synced between different CLO-SET (merged) accounts. * **Resolution** : choose 1 main email address to be used moving forward, and contact support team by **[submitting a request](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new?ticket_form_id=44414746707993)**.
